newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean KFA buys Indian soymeal from Peter Cremer.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean KFA buys Indian soymeal from Peter Cremer.

text.p: The Korea Feed Association (KFA) on Monday bought 30,000 to 35,000 tonnes of Indian soymeal from Singapore-based trading house Peter Cremer, traders said.
The KFA invited tenders to buy up to 125,000 tonnes of soymeal on January 8, but passed on tenders for the remaining amount, they said.
The KFA bought a cargo of between 15,000 and 20,000 tonnes at $305 per tonne, C&F, at the seller's option and another cargo of 15,000 tonnes at $305.40.
Shipment was set for March 20 for both cargoes, with arrivals slated for Inchon for the first cargo and for Ulsan and Kunsan for the other, they said.
